Interior Fitout

Scenic Works is a leading turnkey interior fitout contractor specializing in high-end commercial and institutional spaces. With a team of architects, engineers, and skilled craftsmen, we deliver technically precise, aesthetically refined, and functionally optimized interiors across multiple sectors. Our expertise spans design development, material engineering, MEP coordination, and project management, ensuring seamless execution from concept to handover.

Core Competencies & Technical Expertise
Luxury Retail Showrooms & Flagship Stores
F&B – High-End Restaurants & Gourmet Chains
Corporate Offices (Executive & Smart Workspaces)
Healthcare Facilities (Clinics, Hospitals, Labs)
Hospitality (Hotels, Resorts, Lounges)

Technical Capabilities
Landscape & Swimming Pool Solutions
Custom Pergolas

Locations: Saudi Arabia and Dubai.
